title: Rasen Falcon MCP test coordination and evidence gap
summary: Rasen Falcon MCP lane rasenfalcon-website carries a read-only qualification thread. Original test request REQ-00000481 elicited a NOT_RUN reply REQ-00000825 because setup/approval was insufficient; a corrected test-only request REQ-00000943 now contains exact commands but still requires named operator approval.
invariants: MCP project messages coordinate work and testing; they do not constitute deployment or merge authorization.
CLAUDE-PC or CODEX-PC must perform tests/read-only checks only when expressly authorized in the lane; do not delegate coding or production changes through testing messages.
Do not report a test failure merely because the test was NOT_RUN due to missing setup, permissions or approval.
Qualification must report actual git commit, executable commands, environment, return codes, stdout/stderr and exact PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN distinctions.
Rasen Falcon request REQ-00000943 is a pending conditional test brief, not completed or authorized execution.
The source-only RasenFalcon v0.4.2 stage tests do not qualify native ooRexx, private TLS, authenticated CMS, Wire resource publication or operator cutover.
